reason_for_revision: Use a continuous signed-net EV v2 route objective with adjacent-link boundary speeds and nonnegative kinetic-potential reweighting; remove the per-link stop-start energy estimator that admitted a negative reversal cycle. Preserve SUMO motion-trace energy for actual outcomes and freeze route-query traffic/signal weights to the live planning snapshot.

planning_delay.definition: For each order, apply its frozen measured planner_wall_time_s from the source R1 run as virtual route-planning delay. SUMO signals, background traffic, and other active vehicles continue during this delay; the logical vehicle waits until the delay has elapsed before it departs.
planning_delay.reason: Keep planning time in simulated completion time while preventing host-load variation in a live perf_counter measurement from changing signal phases and traffic interactions across repeats.

cost_model.reported_energy_source: shared model evaluated over 0.1 s SUMO speed trace; acceleration derived from successive speeds
cost_model.vehicle_calibration: generic reference profile assumption; not calibrated to Porto vehicles
cost_model.missing_grade_policy: flat grade assumption, recorded in per-trip fidelity metadata

interpretation_limits: Traffic, signal phases, and energy remain SUMO simulation outputs; they are not observed Porto real-time states.
Energy uses the generic reference profile and an observed SUMO motion trace; it is a simulation estimate, not a measured Porto fleet value.
The frozen planning delays are measured R1 latencies replayed as virtual delay. Live wall time is separately reported.
The 90 vehicles/hour background flow is a synthetic stress assumption shaped by historical taxi hotspot weights.
A completed R1 matrix does not by itself establish an AI map-readability effect; LLM and representation-control runs are separate.
This v5 rerun is required because prior completed R1 v1-v3 outputs lack per-step motion traces; their legacy energy summaries cannot be converted to signed-net EV v2.

routing_cost_model.traffic_snapshot: Traffic and signal weights are sampled once at each route-query start and held fixed within that path search. SUMO traffic and signals continue evolving during planning delay and vehicle execution; the next order takes a fresh snapshot.
routing_cost_model.fastest: FIFO earliest-arrival Dijkstra over directed link states and frozen edge/signal snapshot weights.
routing_cost_model.lowest_energy: Dijkstra over (previous_link,current_link,way_suffix) states; signed net EV v2 motion energy is reweighted by K_in/propulsion_efficiency - K_out/propulsion_efficiency. Potentials telescope to zero between stopped route endpoints.
routing_cost_model.edge_motion: Acceleration, cruise, braking, queue idle, and signal idle are integrated on one continuous speed trace across adjacent links with shared boundary speeds. No independent stop-start assumption per link.
routing_cost_model.grade: Flat grade, same as frozen EV v2 profile because the network package has no grade input.
routing_cost_model.scope: Predicted energy is a routing estimate; actual comparison uses EV v2 energy recomputed from SUMO speed/acceleration trace.
routing_cost_model.signed_net_reweighting_proof: For each flat-grade motion step, wheel work decomposes into delta kinetic energy plus nonnegative rolling/aerodynamic resistance work. With propulsion efficiency eta_p and regenerative efficiency eta_r <= eta_p, net battery energy + (K_in-K_out)/eta_p is nonnegative; regen power caps and auxiliary draw only increase it. K/eta_p potentials telescope across route states and cancel for stopped endpoints, preserving the signed-net EV v2 route objective while satisfying Dijkstra nonnegative arc weights.

zero_call_preflight.scope_note: Stratified zero-model-call sample, not the entire 2,000-leg population; formal batch must record route exceptions and all actual trajectories.

actual_energy_missing_trace_policy: Do not estimate missing actual trace energy from route length; preserve null per trip and null aggregate totals when any moving trip is non-estimable. Zero-distance no-op legs remain exactly zero.
